description: This file defines a PHP class named Reward within the Opencart admin extension, specifically within the API controllers. Its primary role is to process reward points related to an order, retrieving the total reward points for a given order ID, and rendering a view with that information.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A controller class in the Opencart admin API extension responsible for fetching and displaying reward point totals for a specific order.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to retrieve reward points for an order. It loads language resources, extracts the order ID from the request, fetches the total reward points from the model, and returns a rendered view with the data.
